description: Trigger a Prefect deployment as a Dagster asset. Optionally waits for the flow run to complete. Materialization metadata carries the Prefect flow_run_id, state, state message, and parameters. Works with local Prefect server and Prefect Cloud.

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.description: Parameters passed to the flow run. String values are templated: {partition_key}, {run_id}, {partition_window_start}, {partition_window_end}.

wait_for_result.label: Wait For Result
wait_for_result.description: Wait for flow completion before materializing.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Only when wait_for_result=True. Max seconds to wait. None=indefinite.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Only when wait_for_result=True. Seconds between polls.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Prefect tags applied to the created flow run.

flow_run_name.label: Flow Run Name
flow_run_name.description: Optional custom flow run name (templated with {partition_key}, {run_id}).

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding a Prefect Cloud API key.

ui_url.label: UI URL
ui_url.description: Prefect UI base URL, for the Prefect Run URL metadata link. Defaults to api_url minus '/api'.

fail_on_flow_run_failure.label: Fail On Flow Run Failure
fail_on_flow_run_failure.description: Fail the Dagster asset if the Prefect flow ends in FAILED/CRASHED/CANCELLED. Ignored in execution_mode='pipes'.

forward_termination.label: Forward Termination
forward_termination.description: Cancel the Prefect flow run if the Dagster run is terminated while waiting.

stream_logs.label: Stream Logs
stream_logs.description: Forward the flow's own Prefect logs into the Dagster run log while waiting (via read_logs, no shared filesystem/blob store needed). execution_mode='poll' only.

stream_artifacts.label: Stream Artifacts
stream_artifacts.description: Forward Prefect artifacts the flow creates as AssetObservation events (or AssetCheckResults, via check_names). execution_mode='poll' only.

check_names.label: Check Names
check_names.description: Only with stream_artifacts=true, wait_for_result=true, execution_mode='poll'. Table artifact keys (dashes read as underscores) matching these become AssetCheckResults.

execution_mode.label: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: 'poll' — plain Prefect SDK, no flow code changes. 'pipes' — official dagster-prefect Pipes client (requires pip install dagster-prefect + open_dagster_pipes() in the flow).

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale. Defines a FreshnessPolicy.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays at 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Max Retries
